evidence_package_revision.purpose: Groups evidence bundle hashes and validates parser completeness

sports_enrichment_run.purpose: Tracks the execution scope and requested capabilities of an enrichment cycle

source_operation_attempt.purpose: Logs individual fetch attempts and mapping decisions per capability

fixture_capability_observation.purpose: Stores serialized fact payloads mapped to canonical fixture and team

fixture_capability_projection.purpose: Links the current selected observation for each capability to the active run

deterministic_team_mapping_policy.policy_implemented: Team-Specific Mapping with Multi-Observation Fixture-Level Copying
deterministic_team_mapping_policy.details: Facts starting/containing 'home_' or ending with '_home' map to home_team_id; facts starting/containing 'away_' or ending with '_away' map to away_team_id. General fixture-level facts are duplicated as separate observations for both home and away teams to satisfy the NOT NULL team_id constraint in the existing repository schema safely.
